Definition: a look; hence (figuratively) striking appearance, revelation, or (by implication) compact
BiblicalUsage: A vision or a look is the word for what the prophets see, and it is grievous wherever it falls. Daniel considers the he goat that comes from the west, Isaiah is told a grievous vision of treachery and spoiling, and the covenant with death is disannulled when the overflowing scourge passes through.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prophets' visions are not comforts but warnings, and the grievous vision is grievous because it is true. God shows His prophets the treachery so they can name it.
